articles.title: Koppal Gavi Mutt Pontiff to inaugurate Dasara 2026
articles.summary: Koppal Gavi Mutt pontiff Sri Abhinava Gavishiddheshwar Mahaswami will inaugurate Mysuru Dasara 2026 on Oct 11; festival ends Oct 21.
articles.body: BENGALURU: Koppal Gavi Mutt pontiff, who’s won accolades as water-conservation warrior and social-welfare sage, will inaugurate the 2026 edition of 10-day Mysuru Dasara festivities starting on Oct 11.Chief minister DK Shivakumar informed the legislative assembly Thursday Abhinava Gavishiddheshwar Mahaswami, 49, has accepted the govt’s invitation. He said, “I spoke to the seer on Thursday morning and requested him to declare the state festival open.”The choice brings a prominent spiritual and social figure from North Karnataka to the centre of the state’s biggest cultural celebration. The Dasara concludes on Oct 21 with a grand Vijayadashami parade.Abhinava Gavishiddheshwar Mahaswami is the 18th pontiff and assumed charge in 2002. His ‘Jala Deekshe’ campaign in North Karnataka focused on reviving and desilting lakes and addressing severe water scarcity. Under his leadership, the mutt has continued its work in education, food and spiritual service, including providing free boarding and educational support to students from rural and economically disadvantaged backgrounds.Koppal Gavi Mutt is known for the annual Gavisiddheshwara Jatre, popularly called ‘Ajjana Jatre’, one of the region’s largest religious gatherings. The mutt has traditionally used the occasion to recognise achievers from different walks of life.The selection of the seer for Mysuru Dasara comes after several names were discussed for the prestigious inauguration. articles.title: Spurs legend Gregg Popovich marries former assistant coach's ex-wife
articles.summary: Gregg Popovich married Mary Barth Budenholzer on Sept. 16, according to Bexar County records. The legendary coach's new wife was previously married to Mike B...
articles.body:
Gregg Popovich coached the San Antonio Spurs from 1996 to 2025, winning a league-record 1,390 regular-season games, 170 postseason games and five NBA championships.

For four of those championships and quite a few of the other victories, one of Popovich's assistant coaches was his new wife's ex-husband.

Popovich, 77, married Mary Barth Budenholzer on Sept. 16, the Bexar County, Texas, clerk's office has confirmed.

Budenholzer is a 61-year-old native of Corpus Christi, according to multiple media outlets, and was once married to Mike Budenholzer , who was a Spurs assistant coach under Popovich from 1996 to 2013. He went on to become the head coach of the Atlanta Hawks, Milwaukee Bucks and Phoenix Suns, winning an NBA championship with the Bucks in 2021.

The Budenholzers are said to share four children and to have divorced in 2016.

Popovich was married to Erin Popovich for four decades until her 2018 death at age 67. They have two children and multiple grandchildren.

On Nov. 2, 2024, Popovich suffered a stroke before a game at Frost Bank Center, the Spurs' home arena. Assistant coach Mitch Johnson was named interim coach. That title became permanent on May 2, 2025, when Popovich stepped down after 29 years as San Antonio's coach.

A member of the Spurs' front office since 1994, Popovich currently serves as the team's president of basketball operations. He was inducted into the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame in 2023.

This story originally appeared in Los Angeles Times .

articles.title: Elevação do nível do mar na Califórnia destrói casas e praias | G1
articles.standfirst: El Niño intensifica ondas no Pacífico, enquanto autoridades se preparam para novos eventos extremos e possíveis impactos de marés mais altas nos próximos meses.
articles.summary: O fenômeno El Niño intensifica a elevação do nível do mar na Califórnia, provocando erosão costeira severa e a destruição de casas em regiões como Malibu e Dana Point.
articles.body:
Pequenas ondas batem contra penhasco de arenito em Encinitas, na Califórnia 16 de setembro de 2026 — Foto: REUTERS/Mike Blake

Em Malibu, o Oceano Pacífico abriu um buraco perto da casa do astro de cinema Nicolas Cage e causou estragos em propriedades à beira-mar. Ao longo da Beach Road, na cidade de Dana Point, as ondas destruíram uma casa e obrigaram a prefeitura a desocupar ou restringir a ocupação de outras 16.

Esses danos, que se estenderam por todo o sul da Califórnia neste verão, foram provocados por uma série de ciclones e furacões do Pacífico Oriental, intensificados pelo fenômeno climático conhecido como El Niño. Embora os furacões não tenham atingido o continente na Califórnia, eles geraram ondas gigantes que se chocaram contra a costa, arrancando a areia das praias e transformando um litoral que faz parte da identidade da Califórnia tanto quanto Hollywood ou o Vale do Silício.

Especialistas afirmam que ondas ainda mais violentas podem chegar nos próximos meses, quando ciclos climáticos naturais, intensificados pelas mudanças climáticas, podem coincidir com as marés mais altas.

“Tudo indica que este será um inverno bastante épico em termos de riscos potenciais”, disse Patrick Barnard, diretor de pesquisa do Centro de Resiliência Climática Costeira da Universidade da Califórnia em Santa Cruz. “Tudo é amplificado pelas mudanças climáticas.”

A Califórnia declarou preventivamente, nesta semana, estado de emergência para ajudar a mobilizar equipes de resgate e de primeiros socorros, em preparação para mais turbulências causadas pelo El Niño, que surgiu em junho. A previsão é de que o fenômeno demonstre seus maiores efeitos até o final do ano e no início de 2027.

Na sexta-feira (25), outro furacão, o Polo, se formou na costa do Pacífico mexicano. Ele pode enviar mais ondas para o norte. As autoridades cancelaram a primeira edição do Ocean Way Festival, marcada para este fim de semana em Santa Mônica , depois que as ondas causadas pela tempestade e o escoamento das águas do furacão Marie, durante o fim de semana do Dia do Trabalho, corroeram grande parte do local do show, logo ao sul do píer.

O El Niño ocorre a cada poucos anos, quando as águas superficiais do Oceano Pacífico tropical central e oriental ficam excepcionalmente quentes, alterando a circulação atmosférica e o clima em todo o mundo.

O nível do mar no sul da Califórnia subiu de 20 cm a 30 cm ao longo do último século. Um El Niño forte poderia elevar temporariamente o nível do mar em mais 15 a 30 cm.

Relacionada ao El Niño está a onda de Kelvin subaquática, que poderia elevar temporariamente o nível do mar em mais 15 a 30 cm. A primeira grande onda de Kelvin do atual El Niño deve chegar à Califórnia no início de outubro, segundo Michael Jacox, oceanógrafo da Administração Oceânica e Atmosférica Nacional dos EUA.

Os efeitos podem coincidir com marés-reinas sazonalmente extremas que ocorrem durante a fase de amplificação das marés do ciclo nodal lunar de 18,6 anos. O El Niño também pode produzir tempestades intensas conhecidas como “rios atmosféricos”, que frequentemente inundam áreas costeiras e erodem os penhascos das praias.

O litoral da Califórnia, geralmente íngreme, até agora poupou em grande parte os moradores das inundações crônicas observadas em áreas costeiras baixas em outras partes do mundo.

Em Carlsbad, uma cidade de 112 mil habitantes a cerca de 56 km ao norte de San Diego, a areia desapareceu quase da noite para o dia da praia de Tamarack, a joia de uma cidade que arrecada 14% de seu orçamento operacional com impostos sobre quartos de hotel.

Adam Young, geomorfologista costeiro do Instituto Scripps de Oceanografia da UC San Diego, visitou Tamarack recentemente, escalando pedras onde antes havia uma praia arenosa. Logo ao sul, o oceano engoliu a praia completamente, invadindo um estacionamento que antes permitia aos visitantes estacionarem a poucos passos da areia.

Os surfistas ainda lotam Tamarack. Mas uma praia que costumava estar repleta de turistas e moradores locais agora tem apenas alguns visitantes que ocupam um pedaço da pouca areia que resta.

“Espero que consigam encontrar uma solução, porque, sinceramente, acho que a Mãe Natureza vai levar tudo de volta até que eles parem com isso, certo?”, disse o surfista Alex Stott após uma sessão matinal. “Está ficando claro que ela pode levar a praia inteira, se quiser, bem rapidamente.”

articles.title: Tiquira do Maranhão ganha selo de Indicação Geográfica | G1
articles.standfirst: Reconhecimento vale para a produção da bebida em cinco municípios. Destilado feito de mandioca tem registros de fabricação no estado desde o período colonial.
articles.summary: Reconhecimento vale para a produção da bebida em cinco municípios. Destilado feito de mandioca tem registros de fabricação no estado desde o período colonial.
articles.body:
De cor azulada, tiquira é bebida típica de São Luís — Foto: Maurício Araya / G1

A tiquira produzida no Maranhão recebeu o reconhecimento de Indicação Geográfica (IG). O registro foi concedido pelo Instituto Nacional da Propriedade Industrial (INPI) na modalidade Indicação de Procedência (IP) e publicado na terça-feira (22).

Na prática, a Indicação Geográfica identifica produtos que ficaram conhecidos por sua relação com determinado território . No caso da tiquira, o INPI reconheceu o nome geográfico “Maranhão” pela reputação histórica do estado na produção da bebida.

🍶 A certificação está relacionada à tiquira produzida em cinco municípios maranhenses :

A área foi delimitada a partir da presença da cadeia produtiva e da continuidade da fabricação tradicional da bebida nesses municípios.

O pedido de reconhecimento foi apresentado pela Cooperativa dos Produtores de Tiquira e Agricultores Familiares de Guaribas de Urbano Santos (Cooptaf Guaribas). O INPI informou que o certificado de registro será emitido eletronicamente.

O uso da Indicação de Procedência, porém, não fica restrito aos integrantes da cooperativa. Produtores estabelecidos nos cinco municípios poderão usar a identificação desde que cumpram as regras de produção e os mecanismos de controle definidos para a IG.

🌱 Para conceder o reconhecimento, o INPI levou em consideração a história e a reputação da produção da tiquira no Maranhão.

Segundo a documentação apresentada ao instituto, a produção tradicional começa com o processamento da mandioca para a elaboração de beijus. Eles passam por fermentação natural e, depois, a massa é destilada em alambiques de cobre para dar origem à bebida.

O termo tiquira tem origem na palavra tupi “tykir”, que significa “cair gota a gota”, em referência ao processo de destilação artesanal da bebida.

De acordo com a documentação analisada pelo INPI, o Maranhão concentra a produção contínua do destilado e possui registros de fabricação desde o período colonial, ligados ao desenvolvimento da atividade agrícola no estado.

O registro também estabelece regras para o modo de produção, os padrões da bebida e o controle dos produtores autorizados a utilizar a Indicação de Procedência. A proteção concedida pelo INPI é para o nome geográfico “Maranhão” associado à tiquira produzida dentro da área reconhecida.

Tiquira já é Patrimônio Cultural do Maranhão

A importância cultural da bebida já havia sido reconhecida oficialmente em 2023, quando a tiquira recebeu o título de Patrimônio Cultural de Natureza Imaterial do Maranhão .

O reconhecimento levou em consideração os saberes tradicionais envolvidos na produção artesanal da bebida, transmitidos entre gerações. O registro também prevê medidas de preservação desse conhecimento e de continuidade da produção.

articles.title: Karol G no Brasil: Detalhes do show que chega a São Paulo em 2027 | G1
articles.standfirst: Turnê 'Viajando por el Mundo Tropitour', que vem para SP em fevereiro de 2027, mescla estilos latino-americanos e reforça momento de dominação global da artista. Veja como é o show.
articles.summary: A turnê Viajando por el Mundo Tropitour traz Karol G no Brasil em fevereiro de 2027 com um espetáculo que une reggaeton e funk na Arena Pacaembu, em São Paulo.
articles.body:
De vez em quando, testemunhamos um show que marca história na carreira de um artista. Foi essa a sensação ao ver Karol G (com 53 mil pessoas presentes, em sua primeira de duas noites esgotadas), no dia 17 de setembro no MetLife Stadium, em Nova York.

O show foi da turnê "Viajando por el Mundo Tropitour", que desembarca no Brasil em fevereiro. E é um retrato da artista colombiana no auge de sua dominação global (até aqui). Abaixo, entenda o que esperar do show de Karol G:

A "Viajando por el Mundo Tropitour" é a quinta turnê de Karol e, a essa altura, ela sabe bem como construir um megashow. A apresentação é calientíssima, com megaestrutura e dividida em cinco atos. Ao longo de duas horas e meia de show, há algumas baladas e muitos, mas muitos, momentos enérgicos e sensuais.

Karol G durante show no Metlife Stadium, em Nova York, no dia 17 de setembro — Foto: Divulgação/Henry Hwu

É o tipo de espetáculo que se espera de grandes artistas pop internacionais, mas, diferente do formato de sempre, não é feito por americanos para americanos.

Ao longo do show, Karol vira a diva latina máxima: vai do merengue ao reggaeton, da música "tejana" ao funk, com pinceladas de vários elementos latino-americanos.

Tudo isso, claro, com uma roupagem pop. Ela faz as vezes de mulher romântica e sensual, organiza um Carnaval no palco, dança coladinho, entoa baladas melodramáticas com uma banda de mariachis, e por aí vai. Até para nós brasileiros, nem sempre alinhados aos hermanos, tudo soa familiar.

Karol pertence à linhagem de artistas (como Bad Bunny, por exemplo) que provaram que não é preciso abrir mão da própria identidade, nem do próprio idioma, para se consolidar a nível global.

Mesmo cantando majoritariamente em espanhol e se atendo às suas raízes latinas, Karol enche estádios, tem parcerias com artistas do calibre de Shakira e Bruno Mars. Neste momento, ela tem a música mais ouvida do Spotify global ("Bby Wow").

Afinal, até mesmo os EUA, essa hegemonia global, têm uma população latina numerosa. Esse público quer se ver nos palcos, e quer ver sua cultura exaltada — não apagada, principalmente considerando o momento político global.

Isso ficou claro nesse show, em que tudo o que Karol dizia era recebido com gritaria. E em pleno território estadunidense, ela não falou sequer uma frase em inglês.

Karol G em show no Metlife Stadium, em Nova York, no dia 17 de setembro de 2026 — Foto: Divulgação/Henry Hwu

Não precisou: em um momento do show, reconheceu no público as bandeiras do México, Argentina, Colômbia, Venezuela, República Dominicana, Nicarágua e até do Brasil.

Em coletiva de imprensa, Karol reforçou que essa era a ideia: representar esse público tão diverso, de uma cultura tão rica, para que todos se vissem na personagem da "tropicoqueta". "Principalmente nesse momento político em que vivemos".

O show tem muitos momentos que falam a língua dos brasileiros. Tem o remix de "Tá OK" do Dennis e Kevin O Chris, "Bandida Entrenada" (composta com Wiu e Tropkillaz), além de diversos momentos de dança com funk e até um quê de Carnaval.

É uma forma dela aproveitar o que temos de energia, mas também uma tentativa de superar um desafio mercadológico que ainda existe para a cantora. O Brasil é a única grande barreira que falta pra Karol: ela ainda não conquistou o público brasileiro como conquistou os latinos lá fora. Afinal, o Brasil é mesmo um mercado difícil para artistas que cantam em espanhol.

Não à toa, o show dela por aqui será na Arena Pacaembu, que tem cerca de metade da capacidade do Metlife Stadium.

Como a própria Karol revelou na coletiva com o g1, ela entende que há um processo para se consolidar por aqui. Ao longo de suas várias vindas, que incluem uma passagem pelo Rock in Rio, ela vem fazendo esse trabalho de formiguinha. Daqui até fevereiro, tem um caminho — segundo ela, com muitas surpresas na manga.

articles.title: Macklemore lança turnê Palestina Livre após polêmica com Ed Sheeran | G1
articles.standfirst: Rapper fará três apresentações em outubro na Europa e promete destinar a organizações de apoio aos palestinos todo o lucro obtido com os shows.
articles.summary: Macklemore fará shows na Europa e doará o lucro da turnê Palestina Livre para apoiar palestinos após ser afastado das apresentações de Ed Sheeran.
articles.body:
Um dos locais que também proibiu Macklemore de se apresentar foi o Raymond James Stadium, na Flórida — Foto: Getty Images/Via BBC

O rapper americano Macklemore anunciou, nesta quinta-feira (24), que organizará sua própria turnê: "Free Palestine Tour", após ser afastado dos shows de Ed Sheeran por suas declarações em apoio aos palestinos.

Sua exclusão como atração de abertura da "Loop Tour", do astro pop britânico, depois de gritar "Palestina Livre!" durante um show em Nova Jersey provocou uma forte polêmica nos Estados Unidos e no exterior.

Em reação, Macklemore anunciou que fará três shows no fim de outubro em Londres, Paris e Dublin. Ele também planeja outros shows nos EUA e disse que todo o lucro será destinado a associações pró-Palestina.

"O que aconteceu comigo é algo maior do que um único artista ou um único palco", disse o rapper de 43 anos em uma publicação no Instagram.

"Quando a classe bilionária pode decidir quais vozes têm permissão para subir ao palco e quais são perigosas demais para serem ouvidas, todo mundo deveria estar prestando atenção. Estamos em 2026. Ser apolítico durante um genocídio não funciona mais", disse.

"As pessoas estão pedindo que os artistas se posicionem, que se informem e que estejam em comunidade. Que usem o palco para algo além do entretenimento. Que resistam quando o chamado a um Palestina livre enfrenta tentativas de silenciamento", acrescentou.

A decisão suscitou uma série de críticas a Ed Sheeran, um dos cantores mais ouvidos de sua geração, que até então despertava amplo consenso.

Durante um show na Filadélfia no último fim de semana, o compositor britânico reconheceu "erros" e declarou que a situação em Gaza era "injustificável".

Outros artistas deixaram a turnê de Sheeran em solidariedade a Macklemore, entre eles Finneas, irmão e colaborador da premiada artista Billie Eilish.

Ed Sheeran se apresentou com Macklemore no Festival de Música iHeartRadio de 2014 em Las Vegas, nos Estados Unidos — Foto: Getty Images/Via BBC

articles.title: Tiffani Thiessen says she ‘got nothing’ for “Saved by the Bell”, didn’t make ‘real money’ until “90210”
articles.summary: Playing Kelly Kapowski made Thiessen famous but not rich.
articles.body:
Tiffani Thiessen said she received low pay for her turn as Kelly on Saved by the Bell .

Her financial picture improved, though, when she joined the cast of Beverly Hills, 90210 , in 1994.

Thiessen's former costar Mark-Paul Gosselaar has also commented on what the teen stars were paid on the '90s show.

Saved by the Bell was big for Tiffani Thiessen 's career, but not for her bank account.

The actress, who played Homecoming Queen Kelly Kapowski on multiple seasons of the teen comedy, confirmed in a recent interview with SiriusXM's Page Six Radio that she and her castmates "got nothing," not even an early peek at episodes.

She added, "We made nothing and we just did our job."

The sitcom starred Thiessen alongside Mark-Paul Gosselaar, Elizabeth Berkley, Mario Lopez, Lark Voorhies, Dennis Haskins, and the late Dustin Diamond between 1989 and 1992.

Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .

"When we went primetime for one season, we got a little bit more," the actress said. "But yeah, I didn't start making real money until I went to 90210 ."

Thiessen went on to portray bad girl Valerie Malone on teen drama Beverly Hills, 90210 between its fifth and ninth seasons. By the time she joined the cast of the popular series, star Shannen Doherty was out, but the rest of the cast, which included Jason Priestley, Luke Perry, Jennie Garth, Tori Spelling, Brian Austin Green, and more, was intact.

In fact, Thiessen and Berkley missed some of Saved by the Bell' s later episodes — without explanation to viewers — because producers had already filmed a graduation, which was ostensibly the end of the show. Thiessen was already off to create problems for Priestley's Brandon Walsh and his friends.

But as for the money coming in because of her sitcom? Well, Thiessen said that she can relate to those posts actors make about receiving minuscule checks for residuals.

"That's exactly right," Thiessen said. "There's actually a funny place, I don't even know if it's still open, called Residuals in L.A., where actors could come in and take their 38 cent check and buy a drink with it."

She said she doesn't think she receives residuals for playing Kelly these days.

"I think it's dried out now," said Thiessen, whose new show is supernatural teen drama Coven Academy . "It costs more to print the check."

Thiessen isn't the only one who's spoken up about the low salaries the teen acts were given in the '90s.

In January 2019, Gosselaar explained on Watch What Happens Live that the Saved by the Bell cast "made really bad deals."

He added, "Poor deals, back then. It is what it is. You move on, you learn. Great experience."

articles.title: Rob Lowe explains why he was ‘the only person happy’ when Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at the Oscars
articles.summary: Lowe was part of an infamously bad Oscars show in 1989.
articles.body:
Rob Lowe did an infamously bad song and dance number at the 1989 Oscars.

When he saw Will Smith slap Chris Rock in 2022, he hoped people would forget what he'd done.

Lowe was then a teen heartthrob who'd performed with Snow White.

Rob Lowe is still humiliated over the, um, musical number that he performed at the 1989 Oscars.

"The worst opening ever," Lowe said Thursday on SiriusXM's Andy Cohen Live . "When Will Smith slapped Chris Rock, I was the only person happy. Because I was like, 'Oh, good. So now that's the worst moment in Oscar history.' But it turns out not really. Turns out I still am dragged, dragged every year."

Smith infamously walked up to Oscars host Chris Rock during the live broadcast of the 2022 event and slapped him across the face after Rock made an unscripted joke about Smith's wife, Jada Pinkett Smith. Ever the professional, Rock continued with the show following the incredulous moment seen by millions of viewers at home.

Rock joked that Pinkett Smith would soon be starring in the sequel to G.I. Jane, the 1997 movie in which Demi Moore's character sported a shaved head. Pinkett Smith has been open about her experience with the hair loss condition alopecia.

Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .

Lowe had his own terrible moment on the Oscars stage back in 1989, as he and Snow White — yes, the princess — performed "Proud Mary" with a cinematic twist.

"This year even, I guess some people didn't love some of the Emmys and they were like, 'At least it wasn't Rob,'" Lowe told Cohen. "It's like, guys, there should be a statute of limitations."

As Lowe has recounted, he did get positive feedback from a comedy great.

"Lucy came up to me afterwards," he noted, "and said, 'Young man, I didn't know you were such a wonderful singer.'"

He's also had John Fogerty, the writer of "Proud Mary," as a guest on his own podcast, Literally! With Rob Lowe .

"John Fogerty was watching it at home," Lowe said. "And he liked it. He forgave me."

And it's not fading away from our collective memories.

In 2018, Entertainment Weekly wrote an oral history of the bizarre entertainment at the 1989 gala.

"The Rob Lowe thing with Snow White was so painful," actress and former talk show host Ricki Lake, who was in another part of the show, said, "like a car accident that you can't look away from."

Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead actor Keith Coogan was embarrassed by his own participation but grateful for Lowe's gaffe.

"Thankfully people don't necessarily remember our nine minutes," he said.

Lowe's latest project is his movie The Musical , in which he did not sing.

articles.title: Dabiz Muñoz, chef, sobre el secreto de la puntilla crujiente: "Freír un huevo se puede hacer muy bien o muy mal"
articles.standfirst: Fuego vivo y mucho aceite: así fríe los huevos el mejor chef del mundo
articles.summary: Fuego vivo y mucho aceite: así fríe los huevos el mejor chef del mundo
articles.body: En la gastronomía de alta cuna, los platos más sencillos suelen convertirse en los verdaderos exámenes de maestría profesional. Lejos de las elaboraciones complejas y las esferificaciones de vanguardia, el laureado cocinero madrileño Dabiz Muñoz ha defendido en reiteradas ocasiones la importancia técnica que encierra esta icónica preparación. A través de sus perfiles oficiales en redes sociales y sus apariciones en televisión, el triestrellado chef de 'DiverXO' ha querido desmitificar la aparente simplicidad de la sartén cotidiana para mostrar su visión exacta del resultado ideal. Para el cocinero de la capital, el dilema no admite medias tintas ni titubeos cuando se trata de definir la textura idónea del plato. Él mismo ha declarado abiertamente su devoción absoluta por el método tradicional más crujiente y sabroso: "Me flipan los huevos fritos en mucho aceite de oliva humeante con puntilla bien tostada y muy crujiente. El resto de la clara no muy hecha y la yema cocinada, pero cremosa, que no líquida", dijo en la revista 'Men's Health'. Lograr ese punto impecable exige seguir con absoluta precisión una serie de exigentes pautas técnicas frente al fuego. Muñoz advierte que una de las mayores claves reside en controlar la paciencia durante los primeros instantes del cocinado en la sartén. En sus lecciones audiovisuales durante una entrevista en 'Lecturas' recomendó el paso crucial para conseguir ese dorado distintivo: "El secreto es aguantar un poco hasta tocarlo para que nos quede bien de puntillita". No obstante, las precauciones con el producto deben comenzar antes incluso de rozar la grasa hirviendo. El chef aconseja cascar el huevo en un recipiente aparte para volcarlo suavemente, recordando siempre a sus seguidores que la destreza lo es todo en este proceso: "Freír un huevo se puede hacer muy bien o muy mal". Rociar aceite caliente sobre la clara y salar en el plato completan la fórmula de un proceso que apenas debe prolongarse unos veinte segundos. Asimismo, esta pasión por la fritura perfecta no es algo fortuito, sino un sincero homenaje a los maestros de la gastronomía de antaño. En un emotivo vídeo publicado en sus redes, el cocinero dedicó esta clásica preparación al célebre chef Abraham García diciendo afectuosamente: "Abraham. Esto va por ti". Una muestra clara de que el huevo frito, tratado con rigor, continúa siendo una joya culinaria inolvidable.

articles.title: Jordi Cruz, chef, desvela la receta que nunca falla: "Mis macarrones son muy facilones y llevan muy pocos ingredientes"
articles.standfirst: El toque secreto de un cocinero estrella Michelin para revolucionar tus macarrones con carne
articles.summary: El toque secreto de un cocinero estrella Michelin para revolucionar tus macarrones con carne
articles.body: La pasta es un plato comodín en cualquier hogar, pero lograr que una receta sencilla alcance el nivel de la alta cocina exige técnica y equilibrio. El laureado chef Jordi Cruz, galardonado con estrellas Michelin, ha compartido abiertamente su truco para salir victorioso cuando toca alimentar a un gran número de comensales. Para el cocinero catalán, la clave de una elaboración perfecta radica en las proporciones y en el cuidado tratamiento de la materia prima. El primer paso fundamental comienza al establecer las medidas exactas de la receta. Jordi Cruz lo tiene muy claro cuando prepara sus aclamados macarrones: "Mis macarrones SOS de supervivencia son muy facilones y llevan muy pocos ingredientes. Para kilo y medio de carne, un kilo de macarrones y un kilo de pulpa de tomate", contó en 'Cienradios'. Con esta contundente base, uno de los miembros del jurado de MasterChef asegura el volumen suficiente para satisfacer a toda la mesa sin perder intensidad. El tratamiento de la carne picada dentro del sofrito resulta vital para potenciar el sabor antes de incorporar los líquidos. Para conseguir esa textura dorada indispensable que carameliza la superficie, el cocinero recomienda trabajar a máxima potencia: "Kilo y medio de carne de ternera, subimos el fuego a toda castaña y doramos hasta que el agua se seque y empiece a ponerse doradita y a chisporrotear". La paciencia al hacer el guiso constituye otro factor determinante para que el tomate reduzca de manera óptima. Jordi Cruz advierte que no hay que precipitarse y que conviene bajar la llama gradualmente: "Bajamos el fuego y dejaremos unos 45 minutos que guise suave". Asimismo, para otorgar un extra de cremosidad y matizar la acidez, sugiere sumar un ingrediente poco convencional en la boloñesa tradicional: "Los macarrones con tomate más ricos no solo llevan carne picada, añade 500 ml de leche para hacerlos más cremosos". Por último, el chef destaca la importancia de cuidar el punto exacto de la pasta antes del toque final de horneado o integrado: "Cuece la pasta 2 o 3 minutos menos de lo que indique el fabricante. Utiliza abundante agua con sal y reserva un poco del agua de cocción por si necesitas ajustar la textura de la salsa al final". Con esta sencilla guía llena de pasión, el cocinero demuestra que la excelencia gastronómica también habita en los platos de diario.

articles.title: Taylor Swift has a message for the haters on her new song 'Cleveland!'
articles.summary: Swift, who dropped a deluxe version of her latest album on Friday, included an ode to her husband, Travis Kelce.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift has returned to many of the same themes in her songwriting throughout her 20-year career, from enduring love to brutal breakups to the toxicity of fame. And even as she has ascended to one of the most powerful stars in the world, Swift can never resist one of her favorite topics: Sending a message to her haters.

In 2010's "Mean," she called out a music critic for his harsh commentary and labeled him a pathetic loser. In 2014's "Shake It Off," she waved away the haters who are always gonna hate. In 2017's "Look What You Made Me Do," she mocked the negative comments about her on the internet. In 2019's "I Forgot That You Existed," she triumphed over a nemesis. In 2024's "But Daddy I Love Him," she skewered "wine moms" who judge her relationships.

The list goes on, and Friday, Swift added a new track to the canon. She released four new songs as part of a deluxe edition of her 2025 album, "The Life of a Showgirl," which shattered records last fall when it sold 4 million copies in its first week. The song in question is called, of all things, "Cleveland!"

Your weekly guide to culture, entertainment, and what everyone is talking about. Sign up for free

When the extended track list dropped this week, the title caught people's attention. If it wasn't a "30 Rock" reference (after all, everyone wants to flee to the Cleve), the song obviously had to be about Swift's new husband, Travis Kelce, who grew up in Cleveland Heights. Kelce recently purchased a $5.35 million lakefront mansion that's a short drive away from his old neighborhood. Plus, when Swift appeared on Kelce's podcast last year, she referred to him as a "human exclamation point."

Kelce indeed gets some shout-outs, though not before Swift starts the track — co-written with her longtime collaborators Max Martin and Shellback — by ticking off a list of critiques that are frequently leveled at her online: About her physical appearance; her limited dancing ability; how she's not a "girl's girl" who supports other women; and her style choices. ("With all of that money, why's she dressed like trash?" Swift sings.)

In the chorus, however, Swift declares that none of that nasty commentary matters — because she found her soulmate who likes her just the way she is: "He already took me to Cleveland and showed me the Heights," she taunts. "So hate all you like, this is the love of my life."

Swift lists a few more criticisms in the second verse and how her man ignores them ("Must not have read that scathing take about how I'm fake"), culminating with a spoken word bridge. "You only need to find one person in this entire world who doesn't find you completely insufferable," Swift says. "And I have an important announcement to make … I found mine!" Later, she adds, "Now I'm wearing white !"

As early reaction from fans streamed in, "Cleveland!" was instantly divisive, which could inspire Swift's future hater-themed lyrics.

Although "Cleveland!" will receive plenty of attention, Swift poured even more resources into another deluxe album song, "Patient Zero." She recently teased that a "Patient Zero" music video, starring Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell, will debut Sunday during the MTV Video Music Awards.

articles.title: Festival 'shines a light' on Scotland's book town Wigtown
articles.summary: A range of local, national and international authors head to Wigtown for its annual literary celebration.
articles.body:
The annual celebration of literature has started in Scotland's national book town.

The Wigtown Book Festival runs across 10 days until 4 October.

It promises national and international guests while also showcasing Galloway to a wider audience.

More than 250 events are taking place featuring - among others - comedian Lucy Porter, actor Sam Heughan and crime writers Louise Welsh and Chris Brookmyre.

I found the book lover's dream holiday in Scotland

Could visiting book lovers boost our towns' high streets?

The first festival was held in the Dumfries and Galloway town back in 1998 after it won a national competition to become Scotland's book town.

It was up against five other places, Gatehouse of Fleet and Moffat in Dumfries and Galloway as well as Dalmellington, Dunblane and Strathaven.

Since then it has seen a stream of writers, celebrities and politicians drawn to the quiet rural corner of south-west Scotland.

In the process, they have helped give a new life to the town which had seen a string of job losses as major employers closed their doors.

Bookseller and author Shaun Bythell has been part of most of the festivals and has seen the difference they have made.

"I've seen the crucial role it plays - attracting visitors, showcasing Wigtown as Scotland's national book town and in highlighting the literature, culture and history of the region," he said.

"It's so much more than just a book festival – and it's about so much more than books.

"The whole community works together to welcome visitors and to show them all that Wigtown and Galloway have to offer."

Festival programmer Lee Randall said the area was home to many superb contemporary writers of its own.

"The festival programme shines a light on all this as well as the region's wider creativity, culture and environment," she added.

"We are very much looking forward to welcoming visitors for 10 days of literature, film, music, theatre, guided walks and discovery."

articles.title: Aitana rememora su accidente con un corsé en un concierto: “Se podía haber roto completamente y me hubiese quedado en sujetador”
articles.standfirst: La cantante ha concedido una entrevista a Vogue
articles.summary: La cantante ha concedido una entrevista a Vogue
articles.body: En ocasiones, los conciertos pasan de ser un disfrute para los artistas a todo un drama que busca ser terminado lo antes posible. Esto puede ocurrir por caídas encima del escenario, fans que no están en consonancia con lo que escuchan o vestimentas que se convierten en trapos por los movimientos de los artistas. Esto es lo que le pudo pasar a Aitana en uno de sus últimos eventos, al rasgársele un corsé y dejando partes de su cuerpo a la vista de todo el mundo. La cantante ha hablado sobre este episodio en una entrevista para Vogue, en la que ha mostrado el estado en el que quedó la indumentaria que llevaba puesta en dicho concierto. “Este me parece muy icónico por el simple hecho de que se rompiese el corsé. Hubo un look que se nos rompió la tela del corsé, son cosas que pueden pasar, pero claro, yo estaba en el escenario y de repente me giro y dije ‘ostras, que se me está rompiendo el corsé’, y claro, era una imagen que quedaba hasta graciosa”, explicaba la cantante mientras mostraba el atuendo. Sin embargo, no pudo evitar sentir una parte de preocupación al ver el estado de la ropa mientras seguía adelante su show: “Pero claro, cada vez que te mueves se te va rompiendo un poco más, entonces se podía haber roto completamente y me quedaba en sujetador, pero bueno, no se hubiera visto nada muy loco”. Evidentemente, esa pieza no iba a aguantar mucho tiempo, por lo que el equipo de Aitana tuvo que tomar una decisión de emergencia: “Tuve que salir y me tuvieron que coser el corsé. Estaba todo el mundo muy agobiado”, explica la artista, aunque reconoce que le garantizaban que no se iba a quedar desnuda. Para concluir, Aitana desveló que le trajeron otra indumentaria que ya había usado anteriormente, pero ella se negó al cambio: “No voy a quitarme este look que me encanta. Lo arreglamos un momento con la máquina y salgo”.

articles.body: HYDERABAD: The annual auction of the famed Balapur Ganesh laddu fetched a record Rs 39 lakh during the Ganesh Visarjan celebrations in Rangareddy on Friday.Sam Praneeth Reddy, a 35-year-old businessman from Vanasthalipuram associated with Arban Reality Group, won the prestigious 21-kg Balapur Ganesh laddu with a bid of Rs 39 lakh, news agency ANI reported.Thousands of devotees attended the annual auction. After the final bid, Reddy celebrated the win by posing with the Balapur Ganesh laddu.Reddy recently returned to India from the United States and started his business under the name 'Arban Groups'. He secured the winning bid against eight other participants in the auction.Last year, Lingala Dasharath Goud won the laddu for Rs 35 lakh.The practice of auctioning the laddu, which is considered auspicious by people in the area, began in 1994. It was bought for just Rs 450 in the first auction, and the tradition has continued every year, ANI reported.A portion of the auction proceeds is kept aside for Ganesh Puja celebrations the following year, while the remaining amount is used by organisers for developmental programmes in the Balapur area.Meanwhile, the grand Shoba Yatra in Balapur village has begun, with devotees set to immerse Lord Ganesha's idol to mark the conclusion of Ganesh Chaturthi.Earlier, VHP National Spokesperson Ravinuthala Shashidhar expressed his excitement over the Balapur Shobha Yatra.Talking to ANI, he said, "The public has gathered on the streets, prepared to welcome the Lord. articles.title: Alex Warren first headliner for Live at Powderham festival 2027
articles.summary: The booking follows a breakthrough period that saw his album Wildchild top charts in the UK and US.
articles.body:
Grammy award-nominated singer Alex Warren has been announced as the first headliner for a music festival.

Warren will top the bill at Live at Powderham 2027 on 26 June. The four-day music festival, which takes place at Powderham Castle, near Exeter, runs from 24 to 27 June.

Warren's appearance follows a breakthrough period for the US star, whose second album, Wildchild, reached number one in several countries including the UK and US.

His hit single Ordinary became one of the biggest songs of 2025 and helped establish him as one of pop music's fastest-rising artists, said festival organisers.

Peter Taylor, co-founder of festival promoter Cuffe & Taylor, said Warren was a "phenomenal talent and it will be an unforgettable night".

Live at Powderham attracted thousands of music fans in 2026, with headline performances from Lewis Capaldi, Alanis Morissette and Teddy Swims.

articles.body: Johnny Depp has often spoken about how fatherhood changed his perspective on life. In one of his reflections, the actor opened up about moving past anger and frustration and learning to appreciate life differently after starting a family.He made the remark while discussing how becoming a father changed his outlook on life. articles.title: In 1996, Denzel Washington paid $6.5 million for two Beverly Park lots from Disney chairman; he planned to build a family home overlooking Beverly Hills
articles.summary: In 1996, Denzel Washington and his wife, Pauletta, purchased two Beverly Park lots from Disney chairman Michael Eisner and his wife, Jane, for close to
articles.body: In 1996, Denzel Washington and his wife, Pauletta, purchased two Beverly Park lots from Disney chairman Michael Eisner and his wife, Jane, for close to the $6.5 million asking price, according to the Los Angeles Times. Washington, then 41, personally negotiated the deal with Eisner. The couple, who had four children, planned to build a house on the site overlooking Beverly Hills and hoped to complete it by the following spring. Their existing home in Toluca Lake had suffered damage in the Northridge earthquake. The purchase came as Washington was already an established Hollywood actor, having won the best supporting-actor Oscar for Glory and starred in films including Malcolm X, Philadelphia and Crimson Tide.Denzel Washington negotiated directly with Michael EisnerThe property deal had an unusual detail. Washington personally negotiated the purchase with Eisner, who was Disney's chairman at the time. Sources said Eisner had received higher offers after the properties were already in escrow, but the deal with Washington went ahead. The two lots were in Beverly Park, where Brian Adler had the listing, while Barbara Robinson of John Aaroe & Associates in Beverly Hills represented the Washingtons. The reported price was close to $6.5 million, the asking price for the two lots.The couple planned a new home for their familyWashington and Pauletta had four children when they bought the property and planned to build a house on the two lots overlooking Beverly Hills. The couple hoped to have the new home completed by spring 1997. Their existing home was in Toluca Lake and had suffered damage during the Northridge earthquake, which struck Southern California on January 17, 1994.Washington was already a major Hollywood starAt the time of the purchase, Washington was 41 and had already built a substantial film career. He had won the Academy Award for best supporting actor for Glory, the 1989 film about an African American regiment during the American Civil War. By 1996, his film credits also included Malcolm X, The Pelican Brief, Philadelphia, Crimson Tide, Virtuosity and Devil in a Blue Dress. His upcoming projects included Courage Under Fire, due for release that summer, and The Preacher's Wife, scheduled for December.His work away from Hollywood also made headlinesThe 1996 report also highlighted Washington's charitable activities. In February that year, an outpatient paediatric wing at Martin Luther King Jr./Charles Drew Medical Center was named after him. Later that month, Harvard University held a Hasty Pudding-style reception honouring Washington for his humanitarian work. He was also a national spokesman for the Boys & Girls Clubs of America, an organisation he had been involved with since his youth. The Los Angeles Times noted that he had attended the club in his hometown of Mount Vernon, New York, and donated time and money to charitable causes.The Beverly Park purchase became a long-term homeThe property Washington acquired in 1996 later became associated with the family's Beverly Park residence. Later property reporting has described the Washington estate as a substantial compound with a large main house and additional amenities. Architectural Digest has reported that the Beverly Park property includes a roughly 30,000-square-foot main house, a guesthouse, tennis court and swimming pool. These features reflect the property's later development, while the 1996 purchase involved two lots on which Washington and Pauletta planned to build a new family home.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? articles.title: Abhijeet Sawant says Arijit Singh's rise to fame was pure destiny: 'If you compare him and me at that time, I was very popular, but he wasn't'
articles.summary: Abhijeet Sawant continues to hold a special place, as he had won the first season of 'Indian Idol'.
articles.body: Abhijeet Sawant continues to hold a special place, as he had won the first season of 'Indian Idol'. He clinched the title in the show's debut season back in 2005, and even though several winners have followed him over the years, the level of stardom and public affection he received remains hard to match.Interestingly, the same year saw the channel roll out another talent hunt, 'Fame Gurukul', which featured contestants including Arijit Singh and Qazi Touqueer. While Qazi went on to win that season and is now seen competing on 'Bigg Boss 20', Arijit has since become one of the most celebrated playback voices of his time. In a recent chat, Abhijeet was asked to compare his career graph with Arijit's, and he credited fate for shaping how things unfolded for both of them.Arijit Singh stayed out of the spotlight for a decade, says Abhijeet SawantSpeaking to Filmygyan, Abhijeet Sawant revealed that although he and Arijit Singh both found initial recognition in 2005, their career paths diverged sharply once their respective shows ended. Abhijeet walked away with a cash prize of Rs 1 crore courtesy of 'Indian Idol', along with a music album deal with the channel, quickly turning him into a household name. Arijit, on the other hand, did not land similar opportunities as a singer right away and had to restart his journey from scratch."After 2005, Arijit stayed away from the limelight. For at least 10 years, call it a blessing in disguise, he went to the music studios, and he worked with all the major music composers, not as a singer but as a producer, as a programmer," Abhijeet said, adding, "He went back to the basics, and he started his journey again, and no one knew him back then."Abhijeet also pointed out the stark difference in the kind of public pressure both of them faced during those years, given how much more recognisable he was at the time."If you compare him and me at that time, I was very popular, but he wasn't. So the kind of pressure that I faced was very different than the pressure that he was facing. He worked a lot for those 10 years and worked a lot with musicians, and then he got his first big song."Abhijeet Sawant calls Arijit Singh landing 'Tum Hi Ho' pure destinyWhile Arijit's debut track was 'Dil Sambhal Ja Zara' from 'Murder 2', it was 'Tum Hi Ho' from 'Aashiqui 2' that truly catapulted him into stardom. Abhijeet believes that bagging this particular song was simply meant to be."'Tum Hi Ho' made Arijit 'Arijit Singh', and that song landing in the lap of any singer… It was all about destiny," he said.'Everyone has their own journey,' says Abhijeet SawantWrapping up the conversation, Abhijeet Sawant made an observation about how audiences tend to judge artistes based on visible success, often being quick to criticise those who haven't achieved the same recognition."It is a flaw with the audience that we keep praising the one who is successful, but the ones we don't know much about, we keep finding flaws in them. That's not all. Everyone has their own journey. Everyone is trying their best to work, live their life. Let them," he said.Arijit Singh had announced his retirement from playback singing earlier this year, though he continues to fulfil prior professional commitments, meaning fans can still expect new music from him in upcoming films. articles.title: Ed Sheeran concertgoers warn artists about sharing political views: 'You're going to alienate' fans
articles.summary: Ed Sheeran fans at his Philadelphia concert warned artists that political statements alienate audiences ahead of his Gillette Stadium shows.
articles.body: Several fans who attended Ed Sheeran’s concert in Philadelphia last weekend after Macklemore was dropped for making "Free Palestine" comments, warned other artists that if they make political statements, they will alienate half of their audience. The "Bad Habits" singer is expected to play his second and third concerts since the controversy this Friday and Saturday at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts, which is owned by Robert Kraft. The New England Patriots owner allegedly threatened to cancel the concerts at his venue if Macklemore wasn’t taken off the tour, according to the "Thrift Shop" rapper. ROBERT KRAFT, GILLETTE STADIUM BOOT MACKLEMORE FROM ED SHEERAN TOUR OVER ‘FREE PALESTINE’ RANT Macklemore also claimed Kraft got other stadium owners to agree to not allow Sheeran to play at their venues if the rapper was still with his tour. "The fact that they’re forcing Ed Sheeran to have an opinion is not right," one woman told Fox News Digital outside last Saturday’s concert. "He wants to stay in the middle – if you have an opinion, that’s fine, but you’re going to alienate at least 50% of your population, and it causes unrest." GOO GOO DOLLS' JOHN RZEZNIK DRAWS LINE ON POLITICS AT CONCERTS: 'I'M NOT GOING TO LECTURE YOU' She said the "Shape of You" singer "just wants to do his music and play his music, and people want to enjoy it. They want to get away from it, and I don’t feel as though they should have to worry about this stuff when they come to a concert." Macklemore was dropped as the opening act for Sheeran’s tour earlier this month after he made pro-Palestinian comments at two concerts. The other supporting acts on Sheeran’s tour quit in solidarity with Macklemore. articles.title: Russell takes pole in Baku as Antonelli hits wall
articles.summary: George Russell takes pole position for Mercedes at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as his team-mate and championship leader Kimi Antonelli crashes out.
articles.body:
George Russell took an imperious pole position for Mercedes at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as his team-mate and championship leader Kimi Antonelli crashed out.

Russell beat Ferrari's Charles Leclerc by a massive 0.837 seconds while Antonelli, who leads the Britain by 81 points in the championship, will start in 16th.

The Italian hit the inside wall at Turn One in the first session and was knocked out.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri was third ahead of Red Bull's Isack Hadjar and McLaren's Lando Norris.

Lewis Hamilton, compromised by running without a tow from another car, was sixth, ahead of the Alpine of Pierre Gasly and Red Bull's Max Verstappen.

With a tow or slipstream worth as much as 0.5 seconds, Verstappen was following Norris on their final laps when the Briton made a mistake and went off track.

That scuppered Verstappen's chances of competing at the front.

But although the four-time champion had looked capable of contending for the front row, Russell was in a league of his own.

On a weekend in which Antonelli's running has been compromised by reliability problems that meant he missed out on half the possible running on Thursday, Russell absolutely delivered on Mercedes' dominant position on this unique track.

Russell has looked comfortable all weekend and never looked in danger of being beaten for pole, his first since the Austrian Grand Prix at the end of June.

"That's probably the biggest margin I've had in my whole career," Russell said. "The lap felt really sweet and the car has been feeling great all weekend."

Leclerc was somewhat taken aback by Mercedes' superiority, saying that the position was what he expected but the gap most definitely was not.

At the bottom of the top 10, there was finally some good news for Williams, for whom Carlos Sainz achieved the team's first top 10 qualifying performance of the year.

Williams have introduced a new chassis this weekend which has brought them down to the weight limit for the first time this season, after being as much as 25kg over at the start of the year.

Along with some additional developments, it appears to have produced a big step forwards, although the caveat is that Baku is a track that suits the characteristics of the Williams car and does not expose its weaknesses.

Team-mate Alex Albon did not manage to secure a tow in the second part of qualifying and was 13th, just under 0,4secs behind the Spaniard.

Antonelli's error came on his second lap of the first session.

He turned into the first corner too early, and the left front wheel clouted the inside wall, breaking the suspension.

He initially tried to get the car back to the pits but was told by engineer Peter Bonnington to park up.

"Let me try," Antonelli pleaded, before Bonnington told him that either the track rod or upright was broken and there was no way Mercedes could fix that in the time they had to turn the car around before the next session.
